summary: Expanded the housing repair/remodel supplier node using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Home Depot is included only as a context anchor because its SRS and GMS acquisitions validate the strategic value of professional-contractor distribution density. Underfollowed lane: BlueLinx, SiteOne, and Installed Building Products map more directly to obscure or second-order bottlenecks: wholesale building-products distribution, landscape/hardscape contractor supply, and installer labor/product-line capacity. These are not recommendations; they are research candidates requiring further evidence on end-market mix, customer concentration, leverage, inventory cycles, and housing-turnover sensitivity.
